title: Moment: Co-optimizing Physical Communication Topology and Data Placement for Multi-GPU Out-of-core GNN Training
problem: Training large-scale Graph Neural Networks faces memory constraints: distributed systems require expensive memory scaling, while single-machine out-of-core approaches are limited by GPU/PCIe throughput. Existing systems trade off throughput for cost.
motivation: A single multi-GPU machine with intelligent data placement and communication topology optimization can achieve high throughput at low cost by addressing communication contention and GPU load imbalance.
method: Present Moment, a co-optimizer for physical communication topology and data placement in multi-GPU GNN training. Model topology as capacity-constrained directed graphs, formulate communication scheduling as max-flow problem, and use data-distribution-aware knapsack algorithm for placement.
key_novelty: Joint optimization of physical topology and data placement for out-of-core GNN training; max-flow formulation for communication scheduling; data-distribution-aware placement algorithm.
contributions: Moment co-optimization framework for multi-GPU GNN training
Max-flow model for communication scheduling and contention resolution
Data-distribution-aware knapsack algorithm for data placement
3.02x speedup over distributed approaches with 50% lower cost
limitations: Evaluation limited to specific GNN architectures and datasets; scalability beyond 8+ GPUs not discussed; applicability to other graph algorithms not addressed.
